title: SYNAPSE: Framework for Neuron Analysis and Perturbation in Sequence Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2603.08424v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In recent years, Artificial Intelligence has become a powerful partner for complex tasks such as data analysis, prediction, and problem-solving, yet its lack of transparency raises concerns about its reliability. In sensitive domains such as healthcare or cybersecurity, ensuring transparency, trustworthiness, and robustness is essential, since the consequences of wrong decisions or successful attacks can be severe. To overcome these limitations, this work proposes SYNAPSE, a systematic, training-free framework (requiring no retraining of the base model) for understanding and stress-testing the internal behavior of Transformer models across domains. translated_title: SYNAPSE：面向序列编码的神经元分析与扰动框架
translated_abstract: 近年来，人工智能已成为数据分析、预测和问题解决等复杂任务的强大伙伴，但其缺乏透明度引发了人们对其可靠性的担忧。在医疗保健或网络安全等敏感领域，确保透明度、可信度和鲁棒性至关重要，因为错误决策或遭受成功攻击的后果可能非常严重。为了克服这些局限，本工作提出了SYNAPSE，这是一个系统性的、无需训练的框架（无需对基础模型进行重新训练），用于理解和压力测试Transformer模型在不同领域的内部行为。SYNAPSE提取各层的[CLS]表示，训练一个轻量级线性探针以获得全局和逐类别的神经元排名，并在推理过程中应用前向钩子干预。这种设计使得可以在不改变基础模型的情况下，对内部表示进行受控的、可重复的实验。
tldr: SYNAPSE是一个无需重新训练的系统化框架，通过提取逐层[CLS]表示、线性探针获取神经元排名以及前向钩子干预，实现对Transformer模型内部行为的透明分析与压力测试。
en_tdlr: SYNAPSE is a systematic, training-free framework that understands and stress-tests Transformer internal behavior by extracting per-layer [CLS] representations, training lightweight linear probes for neuron rankings, and applying forward-hook interventions during inference.
